newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady with focus turning to November.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady with focus turning to November.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady from Friday's levels as October business was coming to a close and the focus turned to November, traders said. Naphtha was priced $228/$230 cif and one trader said light end-user demand was supporting prices. "With Skikda reopened it has killed off some of the insurance buying that was done last week...but naphtha is not about to come off," he said. Algeria's Skikda port reopened for loadings on Friday after closing last Tuesday due to bad weather. -- John Hanley, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8185
